reviews.text: In a word, AWESOME! :) Professional, courteous, kind and understanding. Casper the groomer arrived at our home on schedule and took time to familiarize himself with our Pembroke Welsh Corgi - Cali the California Girl (AKC Champion Show Dog - Ret). He then gave Cali the full service spa treatment that she has been long accustomed to receiving from her show dog career. We contacted AWESOME DOGGIES because of a severe injury to our regular groomer and we wanted to keep Cali on her monthly grooming routine. We greatly appreciate how flexible and accommodating AWESOME DOGGIES was since we are new clients. Communication via email and text message works very well, plus the paperwork to fill out was clear, concise and easy to complete. Five stars! *****

My dog Bordie absolutely lights up when his favorite groomer, Alex, arrives. Alex is truly the best! Bordie is a 100-pound, high-energy Lab puppy who can be anxious during bath time, but Alex handles him with patience and care. Even though he’s not a fan of bath time, he loves when she comes. So much so that as soon as the grooming truck pulls up, he’s waiting at the door, tail wagging. After greeting her he hops right into the cart ready go.
